whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Tasty Treat Restro & Cafe,

I noticed your cafe has strong 4.0★ reviews with over 1,000 diners in Boring Canal Road, but lacked an advanced digital menu and instant table booking widget for weekend crowds.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table reservation, signature biryani/tandoor showcase, aur mobile-friendly menu integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://tasty-treat-cafe.lovable.app/

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Tasty Treat Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Tasty Treat Restro & Cafe) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with your open-air rooftop vibe, signature biryani showcase, and direct WhatsApp table reservation for Boring Canal Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual menu items aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
